stem: The bar graph shows the total July rainfall, in millimeters, recorded at a weather station in Lahore for each year from 2020 to 2023. By what percent did the July rainfall decrease from 2022 to 2023?

figure.title: July rainfall at a Lahore weather station

solution: Read the graph: 300 millimeters in 2022 and 240 millimeters in 2023.
Divide by the earlier value: \(\frac{60}{300} = 0.20\), which is \(20\%\).

explanation.A: Correct. The rainfall fell by 60 millimeters from 300 millimeters, and \(\frac{60}{300} = 20\%\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the result of dividing the decrease by the 2023 value instead of the 2022 value: \(\frac{60}{240} = 25\%\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the decrease in millimeters, 60, written as a percent. It must be compared with the 2022 rainfall.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the 2023 rainfall as a percent of the 2022 rainfall, \(\frac{240}{300} = 80\%\), not the percent decrease.

verify:
pts = dict(figure['series'][0]['points'])
old, new = pts['2022'], pts['2023']
dec = Rational(old - new, old)
assert dec == Rational(20, 100)
assert value(choices[answer]) == dec
assert all(value(choices[k]) != dec for k in choices if k != answer)
